scope: Read-only public pinned native source and existing client/harness; sole new report artifact. No source/test changes, live actions, SQL, resets, provider calls or private configuration reads.
profile: MAIN 20180704, pre-renewal; pinned source supplied by coordinator
conclusion: Movement announcement precedes authoritative cell movement. Harness closes immediately after observing advertised destination. Native logout cancels the pending walk timer without forcing a cell step, then saves actual current coordinates. Parent differential supports this mechanism: immediate close saved spawn; one-second dwell saved requested next cell. Normal cancellation/save semantics, not evidence of corrupt character data.

evidence.finding: Connect pair pauses one second BEFORE move. Movement predicate tests peer actors x/y against requested destination and returns immediately. Finally closes each client; subsequent limbs reconnect. Total smoke elapsed time is not movement dwell.

Map entry 0x02eb initializes self coordinates. Walking actor 0x09fd places RBUFPOS2 destination in actor x/y, retaining origin in from and walking=true. No 0x0087 self movement dispatch updates actual self position. close uses socket shutdown/close and joins reader; does not send CZ_REQ_DISCONNECT.

Walk parser calls unit_walktoxy with flag 4; target stored in ud.to_x/to_y. Path initialization calls nextcell, which schedules tick+speed before emitting clif_move and clif_walkok. Neither announcement requires coordinates to have advanced.

Pinned observer movement is 0x09fd, not an assumed legacy 0x0086. Packet includes current bl.x/y as from, advertised ud.to_x/to_y as to, speed and movement start tick. Self 0x0087 contains type at 0, start tick at 2, six-byte move data at 6; it is a start/accept notification, not an arrival ACK.

Walk timer resolves actor and advances exactly one path cell through map_moveblock; map_moveblock assigns bl.x/y. Native arrival authority is those updated coordinates. Final path exhaustion calls nextcell with sendMove=false, so normal successful arrival does not produce a mandatory final self walk ACK.

Socket EOF on active ordinary session calls clif_quitsave then map_quit. map_quit removes PC before making save status. Removal stops walking with USW_RELEASE_TARGET only: deletes timer, does not select USW_MOVE_ONCE or USW_MOVE_FULL_CELL, clears path and resets target to current coordinates. Thus logout before first timer leaves spawn coordinates intact.

Normal alive non-nosave/non-instance save copies sd.x/y to last_point. chrif_save serializes status in 0x2b01 with quit flag. Char server saves via char_mmo_char_tosql, then marks offline and emits final save ACK. SQL last_x/last_y derive from last_point, not advertised movement target.

timing.cardinal_step: One current status_get_speed interval in milliseconds after scheduling; DEFAULT_WALK_SPEED is 150, but actual speed must be observed, not presumed.
timing.diagonal_step: Integer speed * MOVE_DIAGONAL_COST / MOVE_COST; source constants 14 and 10. Multiple cells require path-dependent intervals; obstruction, retarget, status changes, delayed movement and scheduler lag can invalidate fixed wait assumptions.
timing.wire_speed: Peer 0x09fd speed field at offset 13 in pinned layout (client.py:696-711), populated by status_get_speed. Self ZC_PAR_CHANGE 0x00b0 sends SP_SPEED var ID 0 at offset 2 and battle_status.speed value at offset 4. Self 0x0087 has no speed byte/field.
timing.prediction: If EOF is processed before first scheduled cell update, stored origin remains; after successful timer update, normal save stores target. Parent one-second dwell demonstrates this one-cell fixture, not a universal one-second arrival guarantee. No exact send-to-EOF timing or wire speed was measured by this source-only review.

arrival_confirmation_candidates_not_impl.existing_authoritative_evidence: Parent exact native saved-coordinate readback after supported cleanup/offline; alternatively normal reconnect 0x02eb gives authoritative accepted-entry coordinates. These are stronger than a sleep or advertised destination.
arrival_confirmation_candidates_not_impl.in_session_snapshots: 0x09fd from records current coordinates at packet construction, NOT its to field. 0x0088 ZC_STOPMOVE carries actual bl.x/y when a correction is emitted (clif.cpp:2204-2213), but no automatic arrival correction is promised. Native idle/spawn position snapshots can establish actual position when freshly generated; ordinary path exhaustion is not guaranteed to resend them.
arrival_confirmation_candidates_not_impl.minimal_self_ack_candidate: Source-supported candidate for future protocol validation, not a fix here: after initial movement request, issue a separately correlated request to the same target and require fresh self 0x0087 whose from AND to equal target. An already-at-target zero-length path sends clif_walkok via unit.cpp:186-192. If still walking, repeated target sets change_walk_target (894-898), and timer/subpath processing can produce the zero-length ACK only after current coordinates reach target. Initial from=origin,to=target ACK alone proves acceptance, never arrival. Must bound retries/deadline and reject stale/unrelated ACKs; candidate not exercised live/offline here.
arrival_confirmation_candidates_not_impl.graceful_quit: 0x018a type=0 gets 0x018b result from clif_parse_QuitGame (clif.cpp:11429-11463); acceptance flushes ACK and optionally sets EOF. It does NOT wait for movement completion or ACK committed database persistence. Public drop_connection_on_quit default is no. It is not inherently stronger arrival/storage proof than current shutdown plus exact offline readback.

configuration_limits.public_defaults: conf/battle/player.conf:143 prevent_logout=10000; conf/battle/client.conf:148 drop_connection_on_quit=no. No live/private configuration read.
configuration_limits.logout_delay_exception: clif_quitsave uses recent canlog_tick to detach socket and delay map_quit by 10000ms; during that interval pending movement may continue. Immediate cancellation explanation applies to ordinary eligible logout, as supported by differential, not every combat disconnect.
configuration_limits.save_policy_exceptions: Dead PCs save restart point; MF_NOSAVE and instance reconnect policy can redirect saved coordinates; logout scripts can affect state. Normal current-coordinate save conclusion is conditional on these not applying. Differential directly demonstrates target persistence in tested fixture.

acceptance.remaining: Coordinator-owned TDD and reliable arrival-confirmation acceptance remain open. Do not weaken movement checks or mutate fixture coordinates to restore acceptance.
